items.title: Health tracking - weight feature and a consistent-score journal
items.description: Two cream health screens: 'Our advanced weight tracking feature' with Macro/Goals/Habits tabs, a dot chart and 'Today's Log' (Check Your Health), and 'Thursday, 28 Jul - By tracking these areas consistently score' with Following tiles (Activity, Diet, Heart), All Health Data and Quick Tracking. A health journal, not a loyalty wallet.

items.title: ChoosingHealth - splash, photo hero and journey arc
items.description: Three staged screens: a white 'ChoosingHealth' logo splash, 'Today is the day, you chose health.' over a photo with Continue with Apple/Google, and a home with a pink 'Your journey' arc (Day 7), Track a meal / Wellness tip chips and a 'Tone & sculpt your upper' workout card. A wellness onboarding trio.

items.title: Frame AI travel planner - food arc, Bali chat, departure calendar
items.description: Three screens: 'Where to next?' with an arc of food photos and Start typing, a 'Frame AI' chat ('I'm planning a 3-day trip to Bali around August 24th' with an itinerary card), and 'When are you leaving?' with August/September 2026 calendars and Continue. An AI trip planner, not a food-trust flow.

items.title: AI cooking assistant - prompt home, recipe orb, ingredient grid
items.description: Three lilac-tinted screens: 'HI Michael, what's on your mind today?' (Talking Notes, Chef To Your Fridge), a 'Milestone AI' orb generating 'an extra chewy chocolate chip cookie recipe' with a waveform, and a recipe screen with an ingredient grid (Butter, Brown sugar, Chocolate, Baking soda) and 'Bake it step by step'. An AI chef, not ambient motion.

items.title: Orbit - dark hero with embroidered wildflower meadow
items.description: A black landing: 'ORBIT - Every workflow, intelligently connected.' with Product/Social/Legal link columns above an embroidered meadow of lilies, cornflowers and poppies. A floral dark hero.

items.title: Design canvas - a grid of dark app screens in a file browser
items.description: A dark design-tool canvas (watermark GPSZTRE.ME) showing two rows of dark phone screens (onboarding, 9:41 homes) with a left layers/frames panel - the working file behind a mood-grid app, not a browse-by-mood UI.

items.title: Agent review toolbar - file diffs, approval and risk chips
items.description: A sparse dark screen with floating control chips: a slider row, 'Send to agent', '4 files +232 -17', an 'Approved' avatar chip and 'High risk - Codex-5.6 SQL'. A developer/agent review toolbar, not a Nepali menu.

items.title: Beethoven Essentials - painted portrait player with top songs
items.description: A classical player over a painted Beethoven portrait with his signature, info/Play/favourite buttons, a 'Featured Playlist - Ludwig van Beethoven Essentials' card ('The drama, the despair, the joy') and Top Songs (Ode to Joy, Moonlight, Für Elise). A featured-artist page.

items.title: 'Enjoy in Light or Dark Mode' - split-theme to-do phone
items.description: A marketing frame headlined 'Enjoy in Light or Dark Mode' over a phone split down the middle: the same to-do list (Buy groceries, Client Call, Walk the dog, a 0:25 voice note, Video Script, 10K Steps, Watch Rings) rendered light on the left and dark on the right. A theme showcase.

items.title: Physics ramp lesson scroll into a collector badge page
items.description: A scroll capture: a 'Lesson' screen with a ramp simulation ('Too much friction — it will not roll!', FINISH flag, Ramp Controls), 'What you'll discover' bullets and 'Why does the ball roll down?' copy, then an 'Onboarded' badge page (Die Carz community, earned by 35.44%, Aug 24 2026, Share). A lesson-to-badge walkthrough.

items.title: 'Onboarded' badge detail - rarity, date and share
items.description: A badge page titled 'Onboarded': 'The Onboarded badge marks collectors who completed their profile and joined the Die Carz community', Rarity 'Earned by 35.44% of collectors', Date earned August 24 2026, Origin Earned, Category Profile, and a black Share button. The same product as VID-0052.

items.title: JIZURA - Japanese kinetic-type editor with timeline and autosuggest
items.description: A dark Japanese motion-type editor 'JIZURA 字面': fields (曲名, タイトルカード・HUDに, アーティスト), tabs (かんばん/詳細/聞く/保存/AE用に書き出し), vertical text '好きだった' on a preview at 00:04.74/00:12.15, a coloured chapter timeline, ループ/シャッフル/おまかせ and 'おまかせで作る' with 前の案 10/59 次の案. A typography video tool, not analytics.
